_comment: Conflict theaters tracked by World Pulse. 'names' are case-sensitive proper nouns matched in headlines/excerpts; 'names_i18n' adds German and Serbian names (case-insensitive, matched after Cyrillic-to-Latin transliteration and diacritic folding; * marks a stem); 'pairs' match only when every name in the pair appears. 'spoken' is how the video voiceover says the name. 'i18n' holds the name and description in other app languages (de German, sr Serbian Cyrillic; the app derives Serbian Latin itself). lat/lon place the theater on the map. Descriptions stay neutral and timeless; the current situation comes from the hourly analysis.

theaters.name: Russia–Ukraine
theaters.description: War between Russia and Ukraine, including front-line fighting in the east and south, long-range strikes, and peace diplomacy.

de.name: Russland–Ukraine
de.description: Krieg zwischen Russland und der Ukraine, einschließlich der Kämpfe an der Front im Osten und Süden, Angriffen mit Langstreckenwaffen und der Friedensdiplomatie.
